description: For a kind of building (commercial, industrial, institutional or residential-multi), the Technical Library's map of what a capital strategy looks at: its functional spaces, and the building elements in play, a page at a time in framework order, each with a link to its service life (every page also grades findings at #severity), how many measured thresholds each market has on it, and the papers that reason from it. Narrow it to the elements serving named spaces (plant rooms, loading docks, wet areas), to one framework section, or count one market's thresholds. General: it describes what such a building turns on, never the condition, cost or needs of a particular building.

cursor.description: nextCursor from a previous call, for the next page of elements.

framework_section.description: Only elements in one framework section, e.g. Roofs, Mechanical Services, Fire Services. Matches on part of the name.

market.description: AU, UK or US: count that market's measured thresholds on each element. Without it, every market is counted.

response_format.description: concise (default): each element's name, links, threshold counts and grounding papers. detailed: adds its short answer.

spaces.description: Only the elements serving these functional spaces, by slug or name, e.g. plant-rooms, loading-docks, bathrooms-and-wet-areas. Leave out for the whole building.

use_class.description: The kind of building: commercial, industrial, institutional or residential-multi (apartments, strata, mixed-use residential).

name: building_brief
title: Brief a kind of building
